title: Stop losing Facebook leads! Connect Zoho Social to Zoho CRM #Shorts
description:
Stop letting Facebook lead ads sit stale in Meta. Learn how to connect Zoho Social directly to Zoho CRM with instant field mapping and assignment rules.

1. Navigate to CRM Setup › Channels › Social and import your brand's ad account.
2. Map your Facebook Lead Ad form fields to your Zoho CRM Lead fields.
3. Apply an instant assignment rule to route the lead to the nearest active sales rep.

API / tool used:
- name: Zoho CRM Leads API
- endpoint: POST https://www.zohoapis.com/crm/v8/Leads
- scope: ZohoCRM.modules.Leads.ALL
- docs: Zoho CRM Insert Records API

AI + Zoho automations every day - follow @GSXAutomation

This video uses an AI-generated presenter and voice.
Independent channel. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Zoho Corporation. Zoho is a trademark of Zoho Corporation.
